role: Member of the Council of States (Ständerat)
organization: Swiss Parliament, representing canton Glarus, FDP/PLR parliamentary group
description: Elected at the federal elections of 22 October 2023, succeeding Thomas Hefti (FDP). Member of the FDP/PLR parliamentary group.

Elected co-president of the national FDP together with Nationalrätin Susanne Vincenz-Stauffacher by the party delegates in Bern on 18 October 2025, succeeding Thierry Burkart. First co-presidency in the party's history.

role: Member of the cantonal government (Regierungsrat); Director of Finance and Health (2021–2024), Director of Education and Culture (2014–2021); Landammann from 2022
organization: Government of the Canton of Glarus
description: Elected to the cantonal executive at the 2014 Landsgemeinde. Headed the Department of Education and Culture for seven years, then moved to the Department of Finance and Health in 2021. Served as Landesstatthalter (vice-president) and from the 2022 Landsgemeinde as Landammann (cantonal president). Member of the Conference of Cantonal Finance Directors (FDK) during his finance directorship.

organization: Landrat of the Canton of Glarus
description: Member of the Glarus cantonal parliament from 2010 until his election to the cantonal government in 2014.

organization: IRF Reputation AG (communications and public affairs agency), Zurich
description: Strategy and communications / public affairs consultant. According to reporting, his official title is 'Senior Advisor Public Affairs'. The agency advises corporate clients; the specific clients he serves are not publicly disclosed.

role: Head of Communications and member of the management team
description: Head of communications and member of the management team at the building technology trade association suissetec, prior to entering the cantonal government.
Worked in communications at the energy company Axpo Holding AG.
Worked as an editor of the regional daily newspaper Die Südostschweiz in Glarus.
